headline: Trump Media Shares Fall 32% After US Midterm Elections
summary: Trump Media investors lost $2.2 billion as shares dropped 32% following the US midterm elections, which were seen as a rebuke of Donald Trump's policies.
why: Trump Media & Technology Group operates social media platform Truth Social and is closely tied to political sentiment surrounding Donald Trump.

impacts.name: Trump Media & Technology Group
impacts.why: Shares dropped 32% following the midterm elections.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors reacted to the US midterm election results, which were widely interpreted as a political rebuke against Donald Trump's policies.
